Ulla Davidsen is a medical professional and governance figure within the Danish clinical quality development framework for cardiovascular health. She works as a Chief Physician (Overlæge) and MPK at Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg Hospital [^src1][^src2]. Beyond her clinical responsibilities, Davidsen holds a leadership position in national registry oversight, serving as a member of the steering group for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database) [^src1]. Her ongoing participation in this governance body is further confirmed in subsequent annual reports, where she is explicitly listed as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] [^src2]. Through these roles, she contributes to the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral efforts aimed at monitoring data validity and improving the evidence-based treatment of atrial fibrillation across Denmark.
